id: title:Gilbert09:classify app db dns blips in the postgres queue consumer as transient

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion and warehouse reconciliation workflows, specifically the fail-open behavior for transient internal database errors.
review.reason: The change replaces a generic transient DB error helper with a more specific one (`is_transient_internal_db_error`) in warehouse ingestion and reconciliation paths. This narrows the scope of transient error handling to explicitly internal app-DB errors while retaining the existing fail-open behavior.
